##: build-windows-allutils job. There is no system coreutils to fall back
on on Windows, so the bundled subset (coreutils, diffutils, grep,
ripgrep) is the product; every channel ships this build, not the
plain ral-windows.exe. The hash is the sha256 published alongside the
release asset as ral-windows-allutils.exe.sha256 -- update both
Does not include ral-sh: a POSIX login-shell shim with no Windows
description: A shell grounded on algebraic effects
